Card Q&A.q: If this Digimon is in my battle area, can I digivolve it into a Digimon with “Green/Level 4” digivolution requirements?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. Effects don't activate from breeding areas, so this Digimon isn't treated as green, and you can't digivolve it into a Digimon that requires a green level 4 Digimon.
